Do you still remember the first time you reversed out of the driveway on your own? That feeling is pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment was probably one of the most heart-pounding of their lives. When you were a teenager, your parents had absolutely no way of knowing how fast you drove, when you arrived at your destination, or how safe your driving behaviour was. No news was good news, and hope was the only real tool they had until you checked in.

If you have a teenage driver today, you should consider yourself lucky, because the fear of the unknown your parents experienced is no longer the world you have to face. Technology in 2026 has plenty of downsides, but HeyPolo is a clear-cut example of tech making life better and safer for teenage drivers.

HeyPolo is far more than a paid version of Apple's 'Find My' feature

HeyPolo is a family safety app that combines real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts and driving safety features all in one, for one price. Among these, the driving feature is the biggest difference between it and basic location-sharing apps (such as Apple's 'Find My'). Every single trip your teenage driver takes is tracked and scored, and you can see the details clearly: how fast they were driving, whether they used their phone while driving, whether there were any sudden braking or hard acceleration, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

The driving score rates every trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you don't have to rely on guesswork to judge whether your son or daughter is really driving safely. You can see the data, and if their performance isn't great you can have a genuine conversation about it. As their driving habits improve, you can also see their score gradually go up. Compared to anything available to the previous generation, this is a far more practical method that truly helps new licence holders improve.

Crash detection, arrival notifications and more — the features keep coming

HeyPolo can detect a crash and automatically notify you. Combined with the arrival notification feature — whether your son or daughter is heading to school, going to sports practice, going to a friend's house, or coming home, you'll receive a prompt — you can shift from the old 'no news is good news' mindset to actually knowing whether they are safe. You no longer have to wait for them to send a text or call you after they arrive; you'll know exactly when they get there, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates your location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, covers the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription covers your entire family, with absolutely no per-person surcharges. It works brilliantly on both iPhone and Android, so households using a mix of different devices have no problems at all. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, which means they have extremely tight privacy infrastructure backing them up. They won't sell your data, you control who you share what with and when you stop sharing, and all data is deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is a very important privacy safeguard.
